title: Actioned report disposition content_removed must soft-delete message and emit deleted event
reproduction: Updating a UGC report status to 'actioned' with disposition 'content_removed' only changed the report row in app.ugc_reports. The offending message remained live and visible in app.room_messages and was still returned to room participants.
proposedRemediation: In updateReportStatus, when status is 'actioned', disposition is 'content_removed', target_type is 'message', and message_id + room_id are present: soft-delete the message (set deleted_at = now(), body = ''), acquire lock on app.room_chat_state, increment next_server_order, and emit 'room_message.deleted' event into app.room_chat_events.

title: Web operator moderation triage dashboard for review and enforcement
reproduction: While moderation API endpoints existed, platform operators had no web UI dashboard to inspect incoming reports, filter by category/status, examine frozen evidence snapshots, or execute disposition actions.
proposedRemediation: Create accessible developer surface at /developer/moderation protected by OperatorGate with category/status/targetType filters, report list, frozen evidence drawer, mandatory operator reason input, and disposition execution controls.

title: Room member lifecycle management controls in web and mobile UI
reproduction: API endpoints for updateRoomMemberRole, removeRoomMember, and transferRoomOwnership existed, but room owners had no accessible controls in web RoomsPanel or mobile RoomsSheet to manage member roles or remove members.
proposedRemediation: Add member lists with roles to web and mobile rooms panels; provide accessible promote/demote toggle, member removal, and ownership transfer controls with confirmation prompts.

title: Explicit personal item to room copy controls with vault and journal exclusion
reproduction: Users had no UI mechanism to share personal notes or tasks into a shared room workspace, nor feedback confirming UUID isolation and vault/journal exclusion.
proposedRemediation: Add 'Share personal item to room' section with item UUID input, preview button (calling previewCopyPersonalItemToRoom), blocked reason display for vault/journal, and copy execution (calling copyPersonalItemToRoom) confirming new UUID and original preservation.

title: Access revocation epoch rotation and client room cache purge
reproduction: When a member is removed from a room, verify that their access epoch rotates immediately, subsequent sync or chat requests receive 403 MEMBERSHIP_REVOKED, polling terminates, and local room caches are purged without touching personal workspaces.
proposedRemediation: Verify rotateWorkspaceAccessEpoch occurs on member removal. Verify client detects MEMBERSHIP_REVOKED, clears displayed room content and chat cache, and rejects unsent queued mutations.

title: Strict functional boundaries between Mute, Block, and Leave/Remove
reproduction: Potential confusion regarding whether muting hides messages, whether blocking removes members from shared rooms, or whether leaving purges personal workspaces.
proposedRemediation: Codify strict boundaries: Mute suppresses notifications/unread counters only; Block prevents mutual invitations and hides messages for blocker only (retains room membership); Leave/Remove terminates room access and purges local room copy while keeping personal workspace intact.

title: Multi-instance realtime clustering limitation
reproduction: The in-process event bus and polling gap recovery are functional for single-node developer/test instances. Multi-instance cluster fan-out is unapproved.
proposedRemediation: Document in-process scope boundaries. Maintain fail-closed production check so that rooms are not enabled on multi-server production infrastructure without an approved realtime message bus.
disposition: Gated limitation in Phase 88 (Retained in DEF-V2-006)

title: Staffed 24/7 human moderation operations and legal dispatch limitation
reproduction: Google Play UGC policy requires robust, effective, and ongoing moderation with prompt action on reports. An AI assistant or automated script cannot fulfill the designated legal human moderation role.
proposedRemediation: Publish concrete operations package (SOP, severity SLAs, CSAM escalation, appeals). Retain DEF-V2-006 and fail-closed gate isRoomsLocallyEnabled() = false in production builds until human staffing and legal contracts are executed.
